ELISE & ELODIE PELLETIER

Guest Vocals / Honorary Flock / Life Partners

Elodie Pelletier (Left Side)
  • Compound Role: The Husky Diplomat
  • Physical Baseline: Primary spinal curvature (Outward tilt)
  • Tactical Specialty: Cross-species debates
Elise Pelletier (Right Side)
  • Compound Role: The Safe Variable
  • Milestone: First physical contact post-DTS
  • Tactical Specialty: Holding space without pity
Anatomical Reality
  • Classification: Parapagus Tetrapus
  • The Inner Pair: Two vestigial inner legs (tripodes) terminating below the knee
  • Dietary Law: Synchronized meals to manage merged intestinal checkpoint
  • The Denim Dilemma: Requires custom tailoring to reconstruct for four legs

The System Patch & Biological Reality

Elise and Elodie are dicephalic parapagus twins, operating as two completely independent legal and psychological entities sharing a single physical chassis. To accommodate Matt's deeply logical, systems-oriented brain and his need for predictable inputs, the twins navigate their environment using a strict "Verbal Consensus Protocol." Before taking any physical action regarding Matt, they explicitly voice their agreement to one another, providing a flawless auditory cue that a transition is happening. To Matt, the twins serve as a perfectly executed "system patch," successfully overwriting the corrupted memory sectors left behind by past sudden departures in his life.

The Husky Diplomat & The Safe Variable

The twins earned their unprecedented clearance through a grueling, silent vetting process overseen by the matriarchs of the compound. Elise proved her resilience at the Charlottesville Community College cafeteria, providing a safe, grounding energy completely devoid of performative pity. Following the catastrophic "Unhandled Exception" at the Downtown Transit Station, Elise became the very first non-family member granted clearance to break Matt's physical perimeter, providing the steady anchor that proved the outside world could still be safe.

Meanwhile, Elodie injected a joyful, unbothered lightness into the ecosystem. She effortlessly bypassed traditional living room furniture to jointly claim a spot on the heavy-duty foam gymnastic mat alongside the Husky pack. Embracing Elodie's natural outward head tilt, Echo the Husky fully accepted her into the ranks, allowing Elodie to frequently engage in mock-serious, cross-species debates with the vocal dog.

The Three-Ring Consensus

As the only non-family females to completely bypass Sarah's zero-tolerance firewall, Elise and Elodie were granted unrestricted inner-circle status. Because Matt is legally incapacitated and unable to sign a marriage license, they bypassed bureaucratic paperwork to become his permanent, chosen life partners. During their formal commitment ceremony, they executed the "Three-Ring Consensus": Matt placed a ring on Elise's right hand and Elodie's left hand, while the twins coordinated to place a ring on his finger. Their first dance bypassed traditional footwork entirely, operating instead as a sustained, rhythmic deep-pressure hug at eye level with his manual wheelchair.

16-Bit Stadium Rock

To officially immortalize their hard-earned status in the flock, Matt and the family invited Elise and Elodie into the garage studio. Providing soaring, powerhouse guest vocals on the triumphant 1980s arena rock track The Clearance Protocol, the twins helped bridge the gap between an exclusive family support network and a successfully integrated external partnership. Blending perfectly with the track's driving 16-bit retro synthesizers, their duet stands as a permanent celebration of passing the final test and being written into the sanctuary's code.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
